# MergeDoc

> Free, client-side PDF and utility tools. Every tool runs entirely in the browser — files and text are never uploaded to a server, there are no accounts, and there is no usage limit.

MergeDoc is a single-page web app offering 86 tools across PDF editing, image processing, text/writing utilities, developer tools, QR codes, calculators, security/privacy, and productivity. All processing happens client-side using JavaScript (PDF manipulation, canvas image processing, Web Crypto), so it is safe to use with sensitive or private documents.

## Categories

- [PDF Tools](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/pdf-tools): merge, split, compress, rotate, watermark, protect, sign, and convert PDFs.
- [Image Tools](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/image-tools): compress, resize, and convert images.
- [Text & Writing Tools](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/text-tools): word counter, diff checker, case converter, and more.
- [Developer Tools](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/developer-tools): JSON formatter, regex tester, encoders, hash/UUID generators, CSS generators.
- [QR Code Tools](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/qr-code-tools): QR code generation, batch generation, and scanning.
- [Calculators](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/calculators): BMI, loan, tip, age, GPA, and more.
- [Security & Privacy Tools](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/security-tools): password generation and text encryption.
- [Fun & Productivity Tools](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/productivity-tools): pomodoro timer, todo list, countdown, and more.

## Blog

- [AES-256 Text Encryption Explained in Plain English](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/blog/aes-256-text-encryption-explained): How AES-256-GCM and PBKDF2 turn a passphrase and a message into safe ciphertext in your browser, and what that protects against.
- [Base64 Encoding: What It Does and Why It Is Not Security](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/blog/base64-encoding-what-its-for): Base64 turns binary data into plain text so it can travel through text-only systems. It protects nothing. Here is how it works and when to use it.
- [Compare Two PDFs and Find Every Changed Word](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/blog/compare-two-pdfs-find-differences): Compare two PDFs for differences in your browser. See added and removed words highlighted, and learn what a text diff can and cannot catch.
- [Compress Images for Faster Websites: A Practical Guide](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/blog/compress-images-for-faster-websites): Resize first, then compress, then pick the right format. A practical workflow for smaller JPG, PNG and WebP images, done free in your browser.
- [How to Create a Freelance Invoice as a PDF, Free](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/blog/create-a-freelance-invoice): What a freelance invoice should include, how to add sales tax correctly, and how to make a clean invoice PDF free in your browser. Not tax or legal advice.
- [CSS Gradients, Shadows and Border Radius, Explained](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/blog/css-gradients-shadows-border-radius-guide): Learn the syntax behind linear-gradient, box-shadow and border-radius, with the values to start from and free generators to preview and copy the CSS.
- [CSV vs JSON: When to Use Each Format (and How to Convert)](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/blog/csv-vs-json-when-to-use-each): CSV and JSON solve different problems. Learn which fits your data, where each breaks down, and how to convert between them without losing information.
- [Flesch Reading Ease Score: What the Number Means](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/blog/flesch-reading-ease-explained): How the Flesch Reading Ease formula works, what each score range means, how to improve a low score, and why a readability number is only a rough guide.
- [How to Test a Regex Online Before You Ship It](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/blog/how-to-test-a-regex): A regex that looks right can still match too much, too little, or hang. Test it against real inputs in your browser before it reaches production.
- [Is It Safe to Upload Confidential PDFs to Online Tools?](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/blog/is-it-safe-to-upload-confidential-pdfs): What happens to a PDF you upload to a free online tool, which risks are real, and how to process contracts and IDs without uploading them at all.
- [Loan EMI Formula Explained, With a Worked Example](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/blog/loan-emi-formula-explained): How the monthly payment formula works, why a longer term cuts the payment but raises total interest, and how to check your own numbers in a calculator.
- [Merge PDF Files Without Uploading Them Anywhere](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/blog/merge-pdf-without-uploading): Combine several PDFs into one in your browser. No upload, no sign-up, no watermark, no file-size cap set by a server.
- [Why Minified JSON Is Hard to Debug (and How to Fix It)](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/blog/minified-json-debugging): Minified JSON is great for machines and painful for people. Learn to format, validate and minify JSON, and spot the usual syntax errors fast.
- [How to Password Protect a PDF (and Remove It Later)](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/blog/password-protect-pdf-guide): Add or remove a PDF password in your browser, and learn what encryption protects, what it does not, and how to choose a strong password.
- [The Pomodoro Technique: Why 25 Minutes Works](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/blog/pomodoro-technique-why-25-minutes): Why the Pomodoro Technique uses 25-minute focus blocks and 5-minute breaks, how to run a session step by step, and when to adjust the timing.
- [Static vs Dynamic QR Codes: Which One Do You Need?](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/blog/qr-codes-static-vs-dynamic): How static and dynamic QR codes differ, what each costs you over time, and how to choose before you print anything.
- [How to Reduce a PDF's File Size: What Works and What Doesn't](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/blog/reduce-pdf-file-size): Why PDFs get large, which fixes actually shrink them, and an honest look at what a browser-based compressor can and cannot do.
- [How to Resize an Image Without Losing Quality](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/blog/resize-image-without-losing-quality): What actually causes quality loss when you resize, why shrinking is safe and enlarging is not, and how to get a smaller file too.
- [Rotate and Reorder PDF Pages Permanently, Free](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/blog/rotate-and-reorder-pdf-pages): Fix sideways scans and out-of-order pages. Rotate a PDF by 90, 180 or 270 degrees and rearrange or delete pages, all in your browser, with no upload.
- [SHA-256 Hash Explained: What It Is and When to Use It](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/blog/sha-256-hash-explained): What a SHA-256 hash is, why one changed letter changes everything, how it differs from encryption, and how to generate SHA hashes free in your browser.
- [How to Split a PDF Into Pages, Ranges or Single Files](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/blog/split-pdf-into-pages-guide): Split a PDF into single pages or pull out ranges like 1-3,5, free and in your browser. Learn which tool fits, plus the limits worth knowing.
- [Strong Passwords vs Passphrases: Which Should You Use?](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/blog/strong-passwords-vs-passphrases): Random passwords or multi-word passphrases? Learn how entropy works, how long is long enough, and the limits of our own generator and strength meter.

- [UUID v4 Explained: How Random IDs Avoid Collisions](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/blog/uuid-v4-explained): What a UUID guarantees, why version 4 is the common default, how unlikely a collision really is, and when a UUID is the wrong choice for your database.
- [WCAG Color Contrast Ratio Explained: AA vs AAA](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/blog/wcag-color-contrast-explained): What a contrast ratio measures, the 4.5:1, 3:1 and 7:1 WCAG thresholds, and how to check a color pair so light gray text does not fail accessibility.
- [Why Client-Side Tools Matter: Keep Files on Your Device](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/blog/why-client-side-tools-matter): Most online file tools upload your data to a server. Here is why many tasks do not need that, and the honest trade-offs of doing it locally.

## Alternatives (comparisons with other online tools)

- [All comparisons](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/alternatives)
- [Adobe Acrobat Online Alternative, Free](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/alternatives/adobe-acrobat-online-alternative): Need an Adobe Acrobat online alternative? Fill forms, sign, protect and compare PDFs in your browser with no upload or sign-in. Compare features here.
- [Diffchecker Alternative: Private Text Diff](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/alternatives/diffchecker-alternative): A Diffchecker alternative that compares text and PDFs in your browser. Nothing is uploaded or saved, no account is needed. See what each tool does best.
- [iLovePDF Alternative: Free, No Upload](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/alternatives/ilovepdf-alternative): Looking for an iLovePDF alternative? MergeDoc merges, splits, rotates and compresses PDFs in your browser. No upload, no sign-up, no watermark.
- [JSONLint Alternative: Private JSON Validator](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/alternatives/jsonlint-alternative): A JSONLint alternative that validates, formats and minifies JSON in your browser. Nothing is sent anywhere, so API responses and configs stay private.
- [PDF24 Alternative: Private PDF Tools Online](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/alternatives/pdf24-alternative): A PDF24 alternative that needs no install and no upload. Merge PDFs and convert PDF to image or image to PDF entirely in your browser, free.
- [QR Code Monkey Alternative, Free](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/alternatives/qr-code-monkey-alternative): A QR Code Monkey alternative for plain, static QR codes. Generate, batch, scan and make vCard QR codes in your browser with no account or tracking.
- [Regex101 Alternative: Simple Regex Tester](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/alternatives/regex101-alternative): Need a lightweight Regex101 alternative? Test JavaScript regular expressions with live match highlighting in your browser. No account, nothing saved.
- [Sejda Alternative: Free PDF Tools in Browser](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/alternatives/sejda-alternative): Want a Sejda alternative? MergeDoc merges, reorders, crops and fills PDF forms entirely in your browser. No upload, no account, no watermark.
- [Smallpdf Alternative: Free, Private PDF Tools](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/alternatives/smallpdf-alternative): A free Smallpdf alternative that runs in your browser. Merge, protect, sign and tidy PDFs with no upload and no account. See where Smallpdf still wins.
- [TinyPNG Alternative: Compress Images Locally](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/alternatives/tinypng-alternative): A TinyPNG alternative that compresses and resizes images in your browser. No upload, no account. See where TinyPNG compression still gives better results.

## All tools

- [Merge PDF](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/merge): Combine multiple PDFs into a single file, in the order you choose.
- [Split PDF](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/split): Pull specific pages or ranges out of a PDF into a new file.
- [Compress PDF](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/compress): Shrink a PDF’s file size for easier sharing and storage.
- [Rotate PDF](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/rotate): Fix sideways or upside-down pages, 90° at a time.
- [Watermark PDF](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/watermark): Stamp a diagonal text watermark across every page.
- [Protect PDF](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/protect): Add or remove a password on a PDF.
- [Edit Metadata](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/metadata): View and edit a PDF’s title, author, and keywords.
- [Reorder Pages](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/reorder): Visually reorder or delete pages, then save.
- [PDF to Image](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/pdf-to-image): Convert every page of a PDF into a JPG image.
- [Image to PDF](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/image-to-pdf): Combine JPG or PNG images into a single PDF.
- [Compare PDFs](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/compare-pdf): See word-level differences between two PDFs.
- [Sign PDF](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/sign-pdf): Draw a signature and place it on a page.
- [Fill PDF Form](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/fill-form): Fill in a PDF form’s fields and download it.
- [Extract Text](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/extract-text): Pull the plain text out of a PDF.
- [Crop PDF](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/crop-pdf): Trim margins from every page.
- [Add Page Numbers](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/add-page-numbers): Stamp page numbers onto every page.
- [Text to PDF](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/text-to-pdf): Turn plain text into a downloadable PDF.
- [Redact PDF](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/redact-pdf): Black out sensitive regions of a PDF page.
- [Split PDF into Pages](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/split-pdf-pages): Split every page of a PDF into its own file.
- [Image Compressor](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/image-compress): Shrink a JPG or PNG’s file size.
- [QR Code Generator](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/qr-generator): Turn any text or URL into a QR code.
- [Word Counter](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/word-counter): Count words, characters, sentences, and paragraphs.
- [Type Master](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/type-master): Test your typing speed and accuracy in words per minute.
- [Password Generator](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/password-tool): Generate strong passwords and check password strength.
- [JSON Formatter](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/json-formatter): Format, validate, and minify JSON.
- [Unit Converter](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/unit-converter): Convert length, weight, temperature, and data units.
- [Base64 Encoder/Decoder](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/base64-tool): Encode or decode Base64 text.
- [URL Encoder/Decoder](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/url-encoder): Encode or decode URL components.
- [Case Converter](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/case-converter): Convert text between UPPERCASE, Title Case, camelCase, and more.
- [Hash Generator](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/hash-generator): Generate SHA-1/256/384/512 hashes of text.
- [Timestamp Converter](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/timestamp-converter): Convert Unix epoch time to and from a readable date.
- [CSV ⇄ JSON Converter](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/csv-json-converter): Convert CSV to JSON or JSON to CSV.
- [Text Diff Checker](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/text-diff): Compare two texts and see word-level differences.

- [Image Resizer](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/image-resize): Resize a JPG or PNG to exact dimensions.

- [Number Base Converter](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/number-base-converter): Convert numbers between binary, octal, decimal, and hex.
- [Text Encryptor](https://mergedoc.vercel.app/text-encryptor): Encrypt or decrypt text with a passphrase (AES-256-GCM).
